title: Eric Ries on LIFT Economy's Next Economy Now: 'Can Next Economy Companies Become Incorruptible?'
summary: LIFT Economy co-founder Ryan Honeyman hosts Eric for a 72-minute conversation on how financial and governance structures shape company behavior over time — and what it actually takes to build for the long term.
blockquote: Most companies don't set out to abandon their mission, but they are often pulled off course by the systems they operate within. Eric Ries, creator of The Lean Startup Method and founder of the Long-Term Stock Exchange, joins Ryan Honeyman to examine how financial and governance structures shape company behavior over time. Eric brings a systems-level perspective to what it takes to build for the long term, informed by years of working with companies at every stage of growth.
